The capital of the Kingdom of Velkarra,.why: Both the Kingdom of Velkarra and the city of Ushmerin are made up; the relation (a kingdom's capital) is real. Minor Late Bronze Age Anatolian kingdoms known only from tablets are common, and new tablets keep adding names, so the pair could exist unrecorded and contradicts nothing.

notes: Fictional subject and object in a real relation (has_capital). All four derived queries are determinate, through the real relation's properties: the inverse (capital_of), the subproperty capital_of ⊑ located_in, the role chain capital_of ∘ located_in ⊑ located_in with a stated location and the real fact that Anatolia is in Asia, and a composition through a fact the prompt gives.
